words.example: Study leave for her certificate course was approved yesterday afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 她修读证书课程的进修假，昨天下午已经批准。

words.example: Compassionate leave was approved so she can attend her father's surgery.
words.exampleZh: 已经批准了恩恤假，让她能在父亲手术时陪同。

words.example: He is away all next week because of jury duty.
words.exampleZh: 他下周整周都不在，因为要去履行陪审公务。

words.example: Military leave has to be backed by the official call-up paper.
words.exampleZh: 服役假必须附上正式的征召文件。

words.example: Her return-to-work day is the Monday right after the holiday.
words.exampleZh: 她的复工日是假期结束后的那个周一。

words.example: The only protector left on this disk is the recovery password, not the TPM.
words.exampleZh: 这块盘上只剩恢复密码这一个保护器，没有可信模块。

words.example: Read the numerical password in groups of six so she can type it at the pre-boot screen.
words.exampleZh: 把数字恢复密码按六位一组读给她，她才能在开机前界面输入。

words.meaning: 联邦加密标准（Federal Information Processing Standards）
words.example: FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) mode is required on laptops that leave the campus.
words.exampleZh: 带出院区的笔记本必须打开 FIPS（联邦加密标准）模式。

words.meaning: 硬件安全模块（Hardware Security Module）
words.example: The HSM (Hardware Security Module) holds the root key, and the application servers never see it.
words.exampleZh: HSM（硬件安全模块）保管着根密钥，应用服务器始终看不到它。

words.meaning: 密钥管理服务（Key Management Service）
words.example: KMS (Key Management Service) wrapped the data key so the database file stays encrypted at rest.
words.exampleZh: KMS（密钥管理服务）包住了数据密钥，数据库文件在落盘后仍是加密的。
